map.📚 深度解析：机械零件三项检测判定（孔径/强度/寿命）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Test for Mechanical Parts (Bore / Strength / Life)
map.零件进场自检：按孔径偏差、抗拉强度、使用寿命三项判定: Part incoming self-check: judge by three items — bore deviation, tensile strength, service life
map.配合可靠：孔径偏差关系装配: Fit reliability: bore deviation relates to assembly
map.逐项判定：孔径偏差≤0.1mm、抗拉强度≥600MPa、使用寿命≥5000h；三: Item-by-item: bore deviation ≤ 0.1 mm, tensile strength ≥ 600 MPa, service life ≥ 5000 h; all three satisfied = pass. Large deviation loosens assembly; insufficient strength breaks; short life needs early replacement.
map.孔径偏差 0.08mm（≤0.1 ✓）、抗拉强度 650MPa（≥600 ✓）、: Bore deviation 0.08 mm (≤0.1 ✓), tensile strength 650 MPa (≥600 ✓), life 5500 h (≥5000 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If strength drops to 580 MPa it fails, insufficient load capacity.
map.约为中高强钢（如 45 调质、部分合金结构钢）水平；须按零件受力与标准牌号定合格: Approximately medium-high-strength steel (e.g., quenched-tempered 45 steel, some alloy structural steels); set the pass line by part stress and standard grade.
map.对精密配合（如轴承孔、液压件）属较严允差；粗配合可放宽，须按公差等级（IT）与配: For precision fits (e.g., bearing bore, hydraulic parts) it is a fairly strict tolerance; coarse fits can be looser — set by tolerance grade (IT) and fit system.
map.孔径测量需使用精密量具，多点测量: Bore measurement requires precision gauges and multi-point measurement
map.抗拉强度测试需按标准制备试样: Tensile-strength tests require specimens prepared per standard
map.关于「检测（孔径/强度/寿命）服务」: About the Bore / Strength / Life Testing Service
